patterns.description: A versioned audit package from an earlier delivery can remain in a branch and look ready while certifying another issue/head/base.
patterns.prevention: Regenerate current specification sources and readiness artifacts from the frozen material candidate.
patterns.detection: Validate certificate material head/base, source identity, and direct result-only child parent/path policy before independent audit.

patterns.description: A remediation can collapse many atomic obligations into one generic requirement and then overclaim coverage by reusing evidence from a narrower control.
patterns.prevention: Preserve atomic requirement identities and bind each material family to discriminant evidence that actually exercises that requirement.
patterns.detection: Compare canonical obligations against requirement cardinality, structural invariant closures, and per-family control evidence before handoff.

patterns.description: A delivery can retain a green suite while persisted run/job identifiers are stale or a requirement is mapped to a different green test that does not exercise its discriminant control.
patterns.prevention: Bind each CI-backed control to an independently resolvable run/job, immutable test blob, reached/passed state, and exact control IDs before handoff.
patterns.detection: Resolve the claimed job independently, inspect the cited immutable test source, and compare requirement/control IDs with the attack matrix rather than trusting a global PASS.
